findings.detail: B01 counted 510 schedule leaves for a current-period fair-value coverage check even though the current June 30 SOI rows have fair-value cells and tie to the filing total of 254,154,676.

rationale: The raw SOI shows actual current-period investment rows carry fair value, e.g. table 9 row 6 has fair value 2,474,237, and the current schedule total ties to the filing total of 254,154,676 at table 13 row 53 and balance-sheet/summary anchors. The bundle flag reports only 252 of 510 leaves with fair_value, which is consistent with the rule denominator including out-of-scope schedule structure and/or the comparative December 31 schedule, not with missing fair values in the current-period extracted holdings. The source therefore supports the stored current-period fair-value coverage and shows the B01 check scope is too broad.
